_comment: SMOKE arm for _golden0729_net305_3h.json — 10 epochs (300 s) at 305 stations.
Mandated by the staged-cadence directive (feedback_test_cadence_smoke_first): a
>= 1 h run is only launched after a clean 10-epoch smoke on the SAME config.
This arm exists to answer three questions BEFORE committing hours of wall clock:
(1) does the whole 'extends' chain flatten so that every armed knob actually binds
(verified against network_run_manifest.json, not against absence of crashes),
(2) are the other sessions' in-flight knobs (sd_ewl, lane spectrometer) confirmed
OFF in the manifest, so this build's uncommitted work is inert here,
(3) what is the real per-epoch cost at 305 stations x GPS+Galileo x 10 threads,
so the 3 h wall clock can be projected honestly.
Only duration and destinations differ from the 3 h arm; snapshots are off.
NOT a grading arm — 10 epochs is deep inside the cold-start ignition transient.
